title: FROM CROWDSOURCED DATA TO HIGH-QUALITY BENCHMARKS: ARENA-HARD AND BENCHBUILDER PIPELINE

bias_targets.methodology: Extending the Bradley-Terry regression model to control for stylistic features such as answer token length, markdown header density, bold elements, and list usage during LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations.

Measuring the ranking shift by comparing human preference rankings against LLM-judge rankings for models originating from the same developer organization as the judge model (e.g., GPT-4 evaluating OpenAI models).
